next.reason: 1985: "are placed in the source program according to the rules for reference format. (See page IV-41, Reference Format.)"; 2023: "shall be in logical free-form reference format. Text-words inserted ... are placed in accordance with the rules of free-form reference format". The extra-space rule is the same; the assumed space at line end is now NOTE 2. But inserted words now follow free-form rules, not the 1985 (fixed) reference format with its areas.
